text: dsh-process-console 是 DeepSeek Harness 网页端的进程控制台插件，在对话视图中添加 Processes 标签页。它按会话展示主 agent 和子 agent 的进程树，并把所选进程的对话事件整理为实时控制台，包括用户与助手内容、思考、工具请求和响应、运行状态、等待交互及错误；还可筛选日志、加载较早记录、查看原始数据、复制单行内容和跟随最新输出。适合需要同时查看多级 agent 工作过程、核对工具调用细节或排查会话状态的用户。需要兼容的 DSH 网页端和 Node.js 22.19 或更高版本；不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-process-console adds a Processes tab to the DSH web UI. Browse the main agent and subagents in a tree, then follow a selected process’s live messages, reasoning, tool calls, results, and errors. Filter logs, load older events, inspect raw lines. Requires DSH web and Node.js 22.19+; no API key.
想在一个页面里实时查看主 agent 和它派生的子 agent 正在做什么
DSH 有没有能把每个进程的工具请求和返回结果并排追踪的界面？
让对话里能按层级浏览子 agent 会话，并切换查看各自日志
I want a live console that follows the main agent and its nested DSH subprocesses.
How can I inspect the exact tool arguments and results for each agent session?
I need to filter a running conversation log and load earlier events without leaving the current view.
dsh-process-console 的功能「进程树」：列出当前会话及其可见的后代子会话，按委派层级显示运行状态；点击某一行即可选择该进程查看内容。
dsh-process-console 的功能「实时会话控制台」：将会话事件按顺序显示为用户消息、助手内容、思考、工具调用与结果、等待状态和错误，并呈现模型、用量和耗时等可用信息。
dsh-process-console 的功能「日志查看与导航」：用户可筛选日志行、切换跟随最新输出、加载较早历史、展开长内容、查看原始数据并复制单行内容。

@softspark/dsh-process-console README · dsh-process-console：The tab sits next to Chat and Trajectory. It lists every process of the current conversation, the main agent and each subagent under it, and prints the selected one as a live console: what the agent wrote, every tool request with its raw arguments, every tool response with its full content, the model behind each step, timing, errors and pending approvals.

@softspark/dsh-process-console README · dsh-process-console：Works on the **published harness**. No patch, no fork, no modified checkout. This is an independently maintained SoftSpark community integration. It is unofficial and is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

@softspark/dsh-process-console README · What's New in v2.0.0：- DSH `0.1.2-rc.1` support through its Session Controller, Conversation, Trajectory, and pending-interaction services.
- Catalog-only children in the process tree and protection against stale pagination after switching processes.
- Enforced 70% coverage and complete browser TypeScript declarations.

Version 2 requires DSH `0.1.2-rc.1`. Keep plugin `1.0.0` when using DSH `0.1.1-rc.2`.

Full history in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

@softspark/dsh-process-console README · Why：Chat shows the conversation. Trajectory shows one session's ledger. Neither answers the question "what is each process doing right now, with which exact request and which exact response". When a parent delegates to subagents the picture splits across sessions you have to open one at a time. This tab puts them side by side and keeps following the tail.

@softspark/dsh-process-console README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @softspark/dsh-process-console --save-exact
```

Restart DSH. The package registers its row itself. For a local checkout:

```bash
pnpm install --ignore-scripts && pnpm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add "$(pwd)"
```

@softspark/dsh-process-console README · Update：Pins are exact on purpose. Move to a newer release by adding it again, then restart DSH:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @softspark/dsh-process-console@<version> --save-exact
```

`dsh plugin --profile web remove @softspark/dsh-process-console` removes the tab and nothing else.

@softspark/dsh-process-console README · What you see：| Column | Content |
|---|---|
| Process tree | The current session as `main`, then every session-backed subagent under it, nested by delegation depth, with a running or idle marker. |
| Console | One line per event in log order. `USER`, `CTX`, `STEER`, `THINK`, `ASSIST` (provider/model, turn, step, time to first token, total, tokens), `CALL` (tool name and pretty-printed arguments), `RESULT` (full content, elapsed time since the call, error code), `RUNNING`, `STREAM`, `WAIT`, `SYS`, `ERROR`. |
| Toolbar | Substring filter, load older history, raw JSON for every line, follow-tail toggle. Scrolling up pauses following; the toggle resumes it. |
| Per line | Copy the body, or expand the raw payload of that one line. Long bodies start collapsed at 30 rows. |
@softspark/dsh-process-console README · What you see：Tool calls include MCP tools, since the harness records them as ordinary tool events.

@softspark/dsh-process-console README · External delegations：One-shot external delegations (`subagent_claude_code`, `subagent_gemini_copilot`) have no session of their own, so a stock harness records only their final answer: they appear as a `CALL` and a `RESULT` in the parent console.

@softspark/dsh-process-console README · External delegations：With the harness-side change described in [`kb/reference/subagent-stream.md`](kb/reference/subagent-stream.md), the provider appends the child's steps to the parent log as ignorable `subagent/stream` events, and this tab folds them into a nested row per child with its own live console. The change is four small patches on published harness packages (`dsh-session`, `dsh-subagent`, `dsh-subagent-claude-code`, `dsh-subagent-acp`), one reviewed set per harness version under `patches/`, shipped by [dsh-drydock](https://github.com/softspark/dsh-drydock) and proposed upstream in a GitHub Discussion, since the harness takes neither external pull requests nor issues yet. Without it the tab behaves exactly as before.
